answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 149848 Country: India Title: Is homeopathic medicine lawful in islam? Question: I heard that homeopathic medicine contains alcohol for preserving medicine. I am suffering from anxiety disorder since 2007. I want to use homeopathic medicine for treatment. Is it allowed in Islam? Answer ID: 149848 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 771/686/SN=7/1438) The homeopathic medicines with alcohol are allowable due to the need and for being widely used by the people; thus you may cure your illness using homeopathy medicine. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
